name: Shakshuta
ingredients: Garlic (2 cloves),Onion (1 unit),Red Bell Pepper (1 unit),Tomato (800 g),Cumin (1 tsp),Paprika (1 tsp),Cayenne Pepper (0.5 tsp),Eggs (4 units),Olive Oil (2 tbsp),Salt (1 pinch),Pepper (1 pinch),Parsley (1 tbsp),Saloia Bread (4 slices)
instructions: Prepare ingredients: Finely dice all ingredients with small cuts.  Sauté aromatics:  olive oil in a large pan and brown the garlic, onion and pepper.  Add tomatoes and spices: Add the tomato and season with salt to taste, simmer for 15-20 minutes until thickened.  Add eggs: Make wells in the sauce and crack eggs, cover and cook until eggs are set (5-7 minutes).  Serve: Serve hot with Saloia bread on the side, garnish with fresh herbs if desired.

name: Avocato Toast
ingredients: Avocado (1 unit),Bread (2 slices),Feta Cheese (30 g),Chili Flakes (0.5 tsp),Lemon (0.5 unit),Olive Oil (1 tbsp),Salt (1 pinch),Pepper (1 pinch)
instructions: Toast bread: Toast the bread slices to your liking.  Prepare avocado: Mash the avocado in a bowl and mix with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.  Assemble: Spread the mashed avocado on the toast.  Garnish: Top with feta cheese, chili flakes, and a drizzle of olive oil. Serve: Serve immediately.
